en: A black and white photograph of a large, multi-story neoclassical building with a prominent entrance and numerous windows. The building is surrounded by a fence, and there are several people, including children, in front of it, suggesting a school or public institution. There is handwriting at the top left and along the bottom edge. The lower left corner contains printed text: 'Raahe, Keskikoulu'.
